description: This PHP file defines a class 'ViewModifyDisplay', which extends 'SugarView' and is responsible for rendering the modification display for connectors in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for rendering module titles, handling the display logic by fetching connector sources, and preparing data for the template rendering.

classes.name: ViewModifyDisplay
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering the modify display view for connector sources within SuiteCRM's administration interface.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the module title parameters, including links to the Administration and Connectors modules, and the current page title.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the name of the module tab, which is 'Administration' for this view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method that prepares connector data, filters enabled connectors, assigns variables to the template engine, and renders the modify display template.
